svg.text: zetokrag/search.py: Searcher.find, called by tools.search_notes. No step calls an LLM, and no score decides for the model. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
PRAGMA data_version changed → rebuild in one read:
ids, BM25 over place + section + text,
vectors fp16 → float32; live scope before fusion
words as typed, with combining marks
Han, Kana, Thai… cut into character pairs
the user's endpoint, the model card's query prefix;
cosine = vectors · q; no vector yet → the lowest;
none, or the endpoint down → words alone, said
min-max per view, then ρ·BM25 + (1 − ρ)·dense
a chunk missing from a view gets 0 there
the user's /rerank on place + section + text;
depth: setting 0–30 (30); the rest, fused order;
none set or down → fused order, no score, said
a copy joins the better-ranked one (also in …)
no threshold, no verdict (`peresearch find`: pages of k)
gone or ambiguous → dropped; copies checked too
changed text → current lines and warning
old neighbors omitted; unique ordered span only
what the index does not hold, counted by reason;
the agent shows what fits (harness frame)
the same fusion, inside a folder when asked
(kept before fusing); each file once, by its
best chunk; the first `depth` reranked on it;
overview: every file, headings, first line
snapshot and every read on the one reading
connection, one thread at a time
the endpoints from the settings (none by default)
best score: answerable vs not, AUROC 0.56
0.60 of the answering passages, the top 10 0.71,
